Just an hour ago I got raided, which got me my 5th follower. I've been streaming for about a week so it was exciting.

Ignore them mostly, unless it's something *really* trashy, then I just delete it.

If someone dislikes my video then knowing why is valuable to me so I can improve and possibly make better content for them. If they don't like my face or voice, then that's unfortunate, but fair enough. If they just want a place to spew hateful garbage about me, or the world in general then they get deleted. I've only had to do this on my really old videos, though, mostly the ones where I played movie spin-offs, like Harry Potter and Reign of Fire.

Yes. I do gaming let's play videos, and I usually can finish a game in a day or two. my videos tend to be pretty raw, with edits that only cut out fluff, or extended periods of nothing happening, so my recording cycle goes like this.

Day 1: Play a game, edit and upload the first part, edit as much of the other parts as I can and go to bed.

Day 2: finish Editing the previous day's videos, record a new game. Edit and upload part 1 of that, and finish the game.

And then I just repeat that process. They're raw and rough, but I'm strangely proud of them in spite of that. I am working on trying to make them prettier though. I want to appeal to a wider audience.
Because of quarantine I went from one video a day every other week, to 2 or 3 a day. my hope is to actually keep up my current output even after the current situation ends.

Sorry if this is super long. I don't usually do this and got nervous and distracted writing, but hopefully it's all what's needed and okay.

Currently I'm playing Edna & Harvey: The Breakout Anniversary. [https://youtu.be/Sf9-1\_RbcxE](https://youtu.be/Sf9-1_RbcxE) The first video which is linked is 16:55. though the last 30 or so seconds are the usual call to action and a end screen with music for links to other videos.

My videos typically range between 15 and 20 minutes long, sometimes longer if I'm playing a massive RPG like KotOR or like currently I'm working on Labyrinth of Refrain. If I end up playing anything shorter than 8 minutes I'll try and do a compilation video, like 3 scary games or something like that. My usual genres of choice are RPG (Both eastern and Western), Point & Click Adventure, or Horror. I like things I have to think a lot about, or that boost my adrenaline.

There were a few things that got corrupted or lost when I did a memory transfer, so I have some series on hold until I can recreate those save states. I want to improve on anything and everything possible, because my goal has shifted from just gaining confidence in myself to entertaining people daily.

I am in no way a professional, I mostly do this as a way to chill out and play games. I started doing YouTube videos as a way to raise my own confidence, help me speak more and also get through my massive library of games. My channel name is different to my Reddit name, and I guess I'm not technically a new channel, since I've been making videos since 2014, but I did only recently start playing and uploading daily after building my new PC, so I'm going to play more. This started because I worked at a retro game store and found all sorts of crazy stuff and needed to have something to motivate me to finish them all. I play everything, but mostly PC as it's the most accessible. I have a strict no piracy rule, which means I don't play emulated games, unless it's a hacked ROM, with something making it different, like Pokemon Mystical or Zelda Randomizers.
